title: Save Diego
hook: Diego 被困在高高的岩壁上，Dora 和 Boots 要找最会爬高的动物去救他。

cells.en: Diego loves helping animals. Baby Jaguar is his best friend.
cells.cn: Diego 最爱帮助动物，小美洲豹是他最好的朋友。

cells.en: “You have to say mira!” Dora says. Mira means look!
cells.cn: “你要说 mira！”Dora 说。mira 就是“看”的意思。

cells.en: Map shows the way: the river, then Iguana Rock, then Diego.
cells.cn: 地图指路：先顺着河走，再到鬣蜥岩，最后找到 Diego。

cells.en: “The mountain goat wants to help us save Diego!” They ride on her back.
cells.cn: “山羊愿意帮我们去救 Diego！”他们骑到山羊的背上。

cells.en: Dora and Boots paddle the raft down the river. Splash!
cells.cn: Dora 和 Boots 划着皮筏顺流而下，哗——

cells.en: “And fast!” They must climb the rocky wall to reach Diego.
cells.cn: “而且要快！”他们得快快爬上岩壁去找 Diego。

cells.en: “Baby Jaguar will lead us to Diego!” says Dora.
cells.cn: “小美洲豹会带我们去找 Diego！”Dora 说。

cells.en: “We need an animal that is a really good climber,” says Dora.
cells.cn: “我们需要一只特别会爬高的动物。”Dora 说。

cells.en: Diego is safe now. “They just want food,” he says.
cells.cn: Diego 终于安全了：“它们原来只是想吃东西。”

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Save Diego”.
ending: In the end, Diego is safe and the goat finds food. My favorite part is ______.
